name: world-map
title: World Map
description: Animated world choropleth: countries fade in from the centre outwards, colour by value, then the highest ones pulse.
useWhen: Country-level values need to be shown on a world map: GDP, users, coverage, sales by country.
A few countries should be called out with a pulse after the whole map has filled in.
avoidWhen: Only a handful of places matter and exact positions do not: use a globe or a plain list.
The story is a single country: use a country map such as us-map or spain-map.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Headline written on with a wipe.

variables.label: Subtitle
variables.default: Nominal GDP per capita in US dollars

variables.label: Source note
variables.description: Small credit line in the corner. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Data
variables.description: JSON object of country name to value. Names follow the Natural Earth spelling, for example "United States of America", "South Korea", "Dem. Rep. Congo".

variables.label: Highlighted countries
variables.description: Countries that pulse once the map has filled in, comma separated (up to 6).
variables.default: Switzerland, Norway, United States of America, Australia, Sweden

variables.label: Colour ramp
variables.description: Colours from lowest to highest value, comma separated hex (2 to 6).

variables.label: No-data colour
variables.description: Fill for countries without a value.

variables.label: Legend low label
variables.description: Text at the low end of the colour bar.

variables.label: Legend high label
variables.description: Text at the high end of the colour bar.

variables.label: Background start
variables.description: Start of the diagonal background gradient.

variables.label: Background end
variables.description: End of the diagonal background gradient.
